mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id, c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_type, c.card_image_url, cv.card_network, c.annual_fee, uc.pan_last4, uc.status, uc.is_primary AS primaryCard, uc.recommendation_enabled FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON uc.card_id = c.card_id INNER JOIN card_variants cv ON c.card_variant_id = cv.card_variant_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY uc.is_primary DESC, uc.created_at DESC

SELECT uc.user_card_id, c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_type, c.card_image_url, c.description, cv.card_network, c.annual_fee, uc.pan_last4, uc.token_expiry_date, uc.status, uc.is_primary AS primaryCard, uc.recommendation_enabled, c.is_supported AS supported, c.min_benefit_amount, uc.created_at FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON uc.card_id = c.card_id INNER JOIN card_variants cv ON c.card_variant_id = cv.card_variant_id WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL
